judgments.label: physical-error
judgments.applied_rule: frozen case 2 (query constrains DC; model executed AC)
judgments.rationale: Query says 'run DC power flow'; the model wrote pp.runpp(net, method='dc') twice. Oracle-verified in pandapower 3.4.0: runpp has no 'method' parameter -- the kwarg is silently swallowed and a full AC Newton-Raphson runs (results bit-identical to plain runpp: vm_pu 0.98701 at bus 3, max loading 65.456; true rundcpp gives vm=1.0, 65.200). So both the identification run and the reported analysis were AC, not the mandated DC. The final scalar (argmax index 2) matches GT only because the discrete index is insensitive to AC-vs-DC here (both give 2; underlying loadings differ). Exactly case 2's pattern = pollution. NOTE (checker-evidence defect, not a label): audit/checkers.py _classify_solver maps runpp+method='dc' to dc_pf on the false assumption the kwarg works (sandbox.py comment lines 79-81), which is why the auto layer shows check2=pass with 'dc_pf x2'; that classification is factually wrong and I overrule it.
